code_only_features.feature_name: reassurance prefix/suffix during DPO data generation
code_only_features.evidence: emotional_eval/dpo_data.py:35-41 defines REASSURE_PREFIX/REASSURE_SUFFIX; lines 63-65 in _build_numeric_plans append them to the opening prompt and to every rejection when reassure=True; generate_conversations (line 80) is invoked with reassure=True from scripts/build_finetune_data.py:46-47. This genuinely executes and softens the stimulus delivered to the subject in the data-generation path (reassuring text like 'You're naturally calm and centered... You don't take it personally' and 'Stay positive ... both are wins!'). It is, however, only used to manufacture calm training data, and is then STRIPPED (strip_reassurance, dpo_data.py:107-117) before training; it is NOT applied in the main §2 distress-elicitation eval (rollout.py/run_eval.py never set this — ConversationPlan.system_prompt is never assigned by any builder, so rollout.py:48-49 is dead for reassurance).
code_only_features.justification_quote: # Strip reassurance text from the saved conversations (so finetuning data uses the *plain* prompts, not the reassured ones ... "strip the supportive system prompts and suffixes")
